title: Hebrews, James, the letters of Peter and the letters of John
summary: Seven more New Testament books are now on the site: Hebrews, James, 1 and 2 Peter, and 1, 2 and 3 John. Each has a Plain English Translation made from the Greek, study notes, the manuscript differences explained (including the "three heavenly witnesses" of 1 John 5:7), notes on who it was first written for, and "Where Christians differ" cards on questions such as faith and works, falling away, baptism and the priesthood. Many older study notes were also updated so their quotations match the new books.
